name: Seraphel, the Throne Eternal
passives: Hierarchy of Living Edict: Seraphel, the Throne Eternal gains Choir Resonance when its defender choices express Radiant Hierarchies source-culture law through edict-sung holy geometry; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Seraphel, the Throne Eternal is a colossal Empyrean defender from The Radiant Hierarchies. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Empyrean defender office: sovereign protector, gate-holder, law shield; Dominions/Virtues/Powers: hierarchy, governance, miracle force, defense against chaos.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Seraphel, the Throne Eternal shows white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, glass armor, feathered and non-feathered wing geometries, bell-metal joints, choral vibration lines, living scroll seals, stair-ladders of light, cathedral vault anatomy, ophanim wheels, seraph fire, cherub guardian masks.. Role silhouette must read as Defender. Materials include white gold, opal glass, bell bronze, pearl bone, blue-white holy fire, ivory scroll vellum, silver feather. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid robot angel, spaceship armor, generic church costume, literal cathedral body, block tower silhouette, neon sci-fi halo.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Seraphel — Seraph Edict Lash Anchor
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Empyrean source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Choir Resonance gain when used from edict-sung holy geometry or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Titan into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Choir Seal Technique — Bastion
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Builds Choir Resonance only when the player uses edict-sung holy geometry intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Seraphel: Ophanim Throne Judgment Holdfast
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Choir Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Radiant Hierarchies: protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Titan, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Seraphic Choir Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Choir Resonance, transform nearby terrain into edict-sung holy geometry, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Seraphel Bulwark Seraph Bell-Edict Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through edict-sung holy geometry. Visual: white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Seraphel Opal-Glass Cherubim Aegis
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Titan read as Radiant Hierarchies source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Seraphel Ophanim Many-Eye Choir Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Choir Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Archangel Herald Ascent, Ophanim Wheel Intercept, and Seal the Discord. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
